categories.main_business_segments: Qingmu Technology primarily operates in comprehensive e-commerce services including e-commerce agency operations, live streaming e-commerce services, brand incubation and management, brand digital marketing, technical solutions, and consumer operations. The company serves well-known global brands across categories such as apparel, sports and outdoor, health foods, beauty and personal care, female hygiene, and pet food. It also engages in distribution agency business and provides integrated IT solutions for e-commerce retail.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced data analytics and AI technologies to empower retail services, including proprietary software systems like Data Mill CRM, Qingmu OMS, Xiaobai system, and Qingmu Woodpecker for automated product listing, image processing, order management, and consumer data analysis. It employs AI-driven algorithms for image tagging, video understanding, and intelligent marketing automation. Qingmu has developed an AI platform integrating multi-modal tools and large language models to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qingmu Technology serves global and domestic well-known brands such as Skechers, ECCO, Lacoste, Emporio Armani, Farfetch, Samsonite, Pop Mart, Jellycat, Under Armour, and others. Its customers span multiple industries including fashion apparel, sports and outdoor equipment, health supplements, beauty and personal care, female hygiene products, and pet food. The company targets e-commerce platforms and brand owners seeking comprehensive digital retail services in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters in Guangzhou and additional operations in Shanghai and Hangzhou. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, Germany, and other international locations, supporting cross-border e-commerce and brand incubation. Domestic revenue accounts for over 97% of total revenue, with a small portion from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingmu Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the e-commerce supply chain, providing agency operations, live streaming sales, brand incubation, digital marketing, and technical solutions. It does not manufacture products but manages brand operations, marketing, sales channels, and consumer engagement. The company also engages in distribution agency business, purchasing goods from brands and selling to e-commerce platforms or distributors, thus holding inventory and bearing inventory risk in that segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on becoming a data and technology-driven retail service expert, emphasizing AI and digital transformation. Key R&D initiatives include upgrading the Qingmu Xiaobai multi-channel product listing platform with AI capabilities, developing intelligent advertising systems like Qingmu Woodpecker, enhancing consumer data platforms (Data Mill CRM), and building integrated digital operation platforms. Qingmu invests in AI-driven automation for product management, marketing optimization, and customer service to improve efficiency and service quality.
categories.revenue_model: Qingmu Technology generates revenue primarily through service fees from e-commerce agency operations and live streaming services, product sales and distribution margins from brand incubation and agency sales, and service fees from brand digital marketing and technical solutions. Service fees may be fixed, variable based on sales commissions, or a combination. Product sales revenue comes from purchasing and reselling goods, bearing inventory risk. The company also earns income from software customization and consumer operation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading comprehensive e-commerce service provider in China, with a strong foothold in apparel and expanding presence in health products and other categories. It competes with other e-commerce service agencies and live streaming operators on platforms like Tmall, JD.com, and Douyin. Qingmu differentiates through its integrated technology platforms, AI capabilities, and extensive brand partnerships. It holds recognized certifications and awards from major platforms, reinforcing its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Qingmu Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, a 19.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 90.5 million, up 73.8%. The company’s gross margin improved to 50.13%. It employs over 2,100 staff with a dedicated R&D team of 179. Cash flow from operations increased significantly by over 400%. The company continues to invest in technology and brand incubation, showing a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingmu Technology emphasizes its unique value as a data and technology-driven retail service expert, offering end-to-end e-commerce solutions that integrate agency operations, live streaming, brand incubation, digital marketing, and technical support. Its proprietary AI-powered platforms enhance operational efficiency, precision marketing, and consumer insights. The company’s deep partnerships with global brands and multi-platform coverage enable customized, scalable services that boost brand visibility, market share, and sales performance in China’s dynamic e-commerce landscape.
